name: pg_union_estimate_array_length
subject: Fix estimate_array_length error with set-operation array coercions
goal:
Planning nested set operations over differently typed arrays can fail while estimating an array expression introduced by type coercion. The internal reference created for a set-operation output does not identify a base relation.

EXPLAIN VERBOSE for `SELECT NULL::int[] UNION ALL SELECT NULL::int[] UNION ALL SELECT NULL::bigint[]` must succeed and show the required coercion to the common array type without a lookup error. Executing it must return three null array rows. Array predicates over ordinary relation columns and set operations without array coercion must keep their current estimates and plans.
